fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Diaphragm/Valve Dynamics with Downstream-Volume Pressure ODE
source: ANSI/ISA-75.01.01-2012 Flow Equations for Sizing Control Valves; Emerson/Fisher Control Valve Handbook 5th ed. (2019) Ch.2 & Ch.5 (regulators, droop, lockup); Driskell (1983) Control Valve Selection and Sizing, ISA; Menon (2005) Gas Pipeline Hydraulics Ch.4; Burnett (1999) JT coefficients for NG mixtures

unit.name: Pipeline self-operated spring-loaded gas pressure regulator (downstream-sensing, direct-acting)

Cv_full.note: Flow coefficient at full open (mid-size pipeline regulator). Fisher Control Valve Handbook Ch.5

Xt.note: Pressure differential ratio factor at choke. ISA-75.01.01 Table

N7.note: ISA-75.01.01 numerical constant for Q[m3/h normal], P[bar abs], T[K] in Q=N7*Cv*P1*Y*sqrt(x/(G*T1*Z))

Z.note: Gas compressibility factor at regulator conditions

A_diaphragm.note: Effective diaphragm sensing area (~200 mm dia)

F_preload.note: Spring preload = k*x_ref at the reference travel (x_max/2). Steady force balance F_preload - k*x = (P_d - P_set)*A_dia gives P_d=P_set at mid-travel; falling P_d with opening = proportional droop, rising P_d as valve seats = lockup

JT_coefficient.note: Joule-Thomson coefficient for NG ~50 bar/288 K (~0.45 K/bar); positive = cooling on expansion. Burnett (1999)
